title: 第9章 好事将近

content_zh:
他确认这事情里面肯定有什么问题，但是他知道的有关东西太少了，根本理不清头绪，不知到底是怎么回事。
这里也不是他一个小小少年能放肆的地方，只能是耐着性子走一步看一步，唯一能做主的就是自我修炼，等待这未知的谜局有一天能解开。
夜空繁星闪烁，屋内榻上无人入眠，倒是榻旁地上有一人倒立。
光着上身的牛有道手持一剑顶在地上，借助剑身笔直倒立着，隐见胳膊略有抖动，似乎在努力控制着身体的平衡。待这支胳膊实在坚持不住了，人在空中换了手把持剑柄，身体大幅度晃了几下，又努力控制住了。练的不仅仅是臂力，也可以说练的是巧劲，维持身体平衡的巧劲，浑身上下每一块肌肉与体躯的协调，这里面能讲究的东西太多了。
更重要的是，练的是剑意，练的是身心与剑协同，也就是人剑合一的意境，达到了这个意境再驾驭手中剑时自然是挥洒自如，分毫之间亦能轻易掌控。
此法乃是《太乙》的特殊练剑法门，心法名为‘混沌青莲意’，身体如此倒立必然造成血液倒流冲头，时间稍微一久，必然令人混混沌沌发懵，倒立如莲苞，功成自绽放。
初期修炼的困难是可想而知的，可若一旦驾驭自如，对剑身承力部位的变化亦能感知的清清楚楚，对将来实际驾驭手中剑有着说不尽的好处。
短短一个来月就能顶剑倒立，看似没什么，实则进度飞快。牛有道以前修炼时，足足花了一年多的时间才练到了这个程度。然而毕竟是有过一次经历，经验和心得这个东西，往往是最宝贵的东西，他有这个感觉和这个经验，知道该怎么做，知道该怎么练，直接跨过了摸索期段，修炼起来不止事半功倍。
只坚持了半个时辰的样子，牛有道已经是汗如雨下，脸涨的通红，汗滴从头顶滴落、从持剑的手上下流，顺着剑身流下，将地面湿了一大块。
最终身体剧烈摇晃，再有修炼经验，臂力摆在这，无法坚持太久，不得不折腰放了双脚落地，扶剑深呼吸静立了一会儿，将身体状态缓了过来。
长剑不敢发出太大动静，怕惊动外面人，轻轻归入剑鞘。扯了条毛巾擦拭了身上汗水，穿上了衣服，活动了下四肢，盘膝坐在了榻上，很快进入了忘我状态，忘却了身体的疲倦，依照练气功法吐纳……
天光微微，晨曦渐明。
榻上盘膝而坐的牛有道较之一个多月前开始时，气息吐纳越发悠长深沉，吸入如江河澎湃直灌五脏六腑，吐出徐徐如抽丝剥茧，似乎在一点点过滤什么。
随着晨曦过去，天色大亮，旭日明晃晃跳出了天际，发出万丈金光，逐渐高升。万物苏醒的时刻也令牛有道渐渐感受到了一丝心浮气躁，知道最佳的忘我修炼时间段已经过去了，缓缓收功睁开了双眼。
下榻之后活动了一下四肢，昨夜倒立带来的疲劳已经一扫而空，神清气爽。
倒不是最佳的忘我修炼时间段过去了就不能再继续修炼了，而是现在的少年身体还未彻底长成，正在茁壮生长期，最是生性好动的年纪，天生的习性难以改变，血气最容易受到天地时令的影响，能抓住最佳修炼时间段修炼就够了，不必苛求勉强。另外，外面会定时送餐，他若一直闭门不出怕会引来怀疑。
一个山村野小子为何会懂修炼？加之不明上清宗对自己究竟是什么态度，有些东西还是不暴露的好，现在完全没自保能力，多一事不如少一事，且等到看明白了情况再做决断。
院子里有引来的山泉流经，洗漱之后，一贯的时间，牛有道听到开门声，许以天回头看了眼，慢慢站了起来。
牛有道走去作礼，两人没聊几句，陈归硕提着食盒上了山，算是来换班的。
许以天离去，中午饭点的时候又会来，傍晚的餐点又该是陈归硕来，总之两人轮流值守，轮流送餐。

上清宗如此看重，牛有道再看不出其中有问题的话，那他道爷在江湖上算是白混了那么多年。

content_en:
He confirmed that there must be some problem in this matter, but he knew too little about it and couldn't figure it out at all. He didn't know what was going on.
This is not a place where he, a young boy, can be arrogant. He can only take it patiently and take it one step at a time. The only thing that can make the decision is self-cultivation and waiting for this unknown mystery to be solved one day.
The stars twinkled in the night sky, and no one was sleeping on the couch in the house, but there was a man standing upside down on the ground next to the couch.
Niu Youdao, who was bare-chested, was holding a sword against the ground. He stood upright with the sword, his arms shaking slightly, as if he was trying to control the balance of his body. When the arm couldn't hold on anymore, he changed his hand to hold the sword hilt in the air, shook his body a few times, and tried to control it again. What you practice is not just arm strength, you can also say that you practice skillful strength, the skillful strength to maintain the balance of the body, and the coordination of every muscle in the body and the body. There are too many things to pay attention to in this.
More importantly, what you practice is sword intention, and what you practice is the coordination of body and mind with the sword, that is, the artistic conception of the unity of man and sword. Once you reach this artistic conception, you will naturally be able to wield the sword freely, and you can easily control it in the slightest.
This method is a special sword training method of "Taiyi". The mental method is called "Chaos Green Lotus Intention". Standing the body upside down will inevitably cause the blood to flow backwards and rush towards the head. After a while, it will inevitably make people confused and confused. Standing upside down like a lotus bud, the success will bloom by itself.
The difficulty of practicing in the early stage is conceivable, but once you can control it freely, you can also clearly perceive the changes in the force-bearing parts of the sword body, which will have indescribable benefits for the actual control of the sword in the future.
In just one month, I was able to stand on my head with a sword. It seemed like nothing, but in fact, my progress was rapid. When Niu Youdao practiced before, it took him more than a year to reach this level. However, after all, he has had an experience, and experience and insights are often the most precious things. He has this feeling and experience, knows what to do, and knows how to practice. He has directly skipped the exploration period, and his practice is more than twice the result with half the effort.
After only holding on for half an hour, Niu Youdao was already sweating profusely, his face flushed. Sweat dripped from the top of his head, from the hand holding the sword, and flowed down the sword body, making a large piece of the ground wet.
In the end, the body shook violently. With my training experience and my arm strength, I couldn't hold on for too long. I had to bend down and put my feet on the ground. I held my sword and took a deep breath and stood still for a while to calm down my body.
The long sword did not dare to make too much noise for fear of alarming people outside, so it was gently sheathed. I pulled a towel to wipe the sweat on my body, put on my clothes, moved my limbs, and sat cross-legged on the couch. I quickly entered a state of selflessness, forgetting my physical fatigue, and followed the Qigong method to breathe out...
The sky is dim and the morning light is getting brighter.
Niu Youdao, who was sitting cross-legged on the couch, was breathing longer and deeper than when he started more than a month ago. His inhalation was like a surging river pouring straight into his internal organs, and his exhalation was as slow as spinning silk and peeling off a cocoon, as if he was filtering something bit by bit.
As the morning light passed, the sky became brighter, and the rising sun jumped out of the sky brightly, emitting a golden light that gradually rose higher. The moment when all things awakened, Niu Youdao gradually felt a little restless and restless. Knowing that the best time for selfless cultivation had passed, he slowly stopped his practice and opened his eyes.
After staying in bed, I moved my limbs. The fatigue caused by the handstand last night has been wiped away, and I feel refreshed.
It's not that you can't continue to practice after the best time for selfless practice, but that the young man's body has not fully grown yet and is in the period of vigorous growth. It is the most active age. Innate habits are difficult to change, and blood is most susceptible to the influence of the seasons of heaven and earth. It is enough to seize the best time to practice, and there is no need to be demanding and forced. In addition, meals will be delivered outside regularly, so if he stays behind closed doors, he might arouse suspicion.
Why does a wild boy from a mountain village know how to practice cultivation? addI don't know what the Shangqing Sect's attitude is towards me. Some things are better not to be exposed. Now I have no ability to protect myself. It is better to do less than to do more, and wait until the situation is clear before making a decision.
There was a mountain spring flowing in the yard. After washing, at the same time, Niu Youdao heard the door open. Xu Yitian looked back and slowly stood up.
Niu Youdao went to salute, and the two of them didn't chat for a few words. Chen Guishuo carried the food box up the mountain, which was regarded as changing his shift.
Xu Yitian left, but came again at lunch time, and Chen Guishuo came for the evening meal. In short, the two of them took turns to be on duty and deliver the meals.
The Shangqing Sect attaches great importance to it, and if Niu Youdao can no longer see any problems in it, then his Taoist master has spent so many years in the world in vain.
